definitions.explanation: A government official who conducts criminal prosecutions on behalf of the state.

examples.japanese: {検察官|けんさつかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}した→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
{検察官|けんさつかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to become a prosecutor.

examples.japanese: {検察官|けんさつかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{被告人|ひこくにん}→被告人：20130_hikokunin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追及|ついきゅう}した→追及する：21385_tsuikyuu⟧。

notes:
{検察官|けんさつかん} is the formal/official term for a public prosecutor. In casual speech and media, ⟦{検察|けんさつ}→検察：11086_kensatsu⟧ (the prosecution) or ⟦{検事|けんじ}→検事：20788_kenji⟧ (prosecutor, less formal) are also commonly used.

FORMS:
⟦{検察|けんさつ}→検察：11086_kensatsu⟧ (prosecution) + {官|かん} (official). The ~{官|かん} suffix indicates a government official.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {検察官|けんさつかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起訴|きそ}する→起訴する：09863_kisosuru⟧: the prosecutor indicts
- {検察官|けんさつかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{論告|ろんこく}: prosecutor's closing argument
- {検察官|けんさつかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{取|と}り{調|しら}べる: the prosecutor interrogates

RELATED LEGAL ROLES:
- ⟦{弁護士|べんごし}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧: lawyer, defense attorney
- ⟦{裁判官|さいばんかん}→裁判官：09562_saibankan⟧: judge
- ⟦{被告人|ひこくにん}→被告人：20130_hikokunin⟧: defendant
- ⟦{検事|けんじ}→検事：20788_kenji⟧: prosecutor (less formal term, same role)
